stock.description: As an investment holding company, TS Wonders Holding Limited is engaged in the manufacturing, packaging, and retail of various food products. Its market presence extends across Singapore, Malaysia, China, India, the United Kingdom, and Indonesia. The company's operations are divided into three primary segments: Nuts, Chips, and Others. Its diverse product portfolio includes a selection of roasted and baked nuts, such as peanuts, cashews, pistachios, almonds, macadamias, and walnuts, alongside different bean varieties like broad beans and green peas. The company also supplies potato and cassava chips, as well as raw potatoes and cassava roots. These goods are marketed under its proprietary brands, including Tai Sun, Nature's Wonders, UCA, and Treatz. Distribution is conducted on a wholesale basis, catering to a wide range of clients such as supermarkets, hotels, airlines, original equipment manufacturers, and other distributors. Established in 1966, TS Wonders Holding Limited is headquartered in Singapore and operates as a subsidiary of SWL Limited.
